NCC Founder A.V.S. Raju, Padma Shri Recipient, Dies at 89

A.V.S. Raju, the founder of NCC Ltd and a Padma Shri awardee, has passed away at the age of 89. Raju was recognized as a lifelong builder of NCC and a pioneer in Andhra business. He died in Hyderabad.
